newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni chief doesn't rule out merger with Snam.
newsitem.headline: Eni chief doesn't rule out merger with Snam.

text.p: Italian energy group Eni, which is planning to absorb its oil exploration and production unit Agip, said on Thursday it could also one day absorb its natural gas supply, transmission and distribution unit Snam.
"Snam isn't to be excluded," Chairman Guglielmo Moscato told reporters at a shareholders' meeting to approve the Agip merger.
"For the time being we have only considered Agip. We'll then consider whether to do other things and when the time would be right."
Asked also about Agippetroli, the refining and marketing subsidiary, Moscato said nothing was yet planned.
"No other mergers are planned in the short term," he added.
